source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 16 (PDF 57-72), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Human Endocrine System) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 While the nervous system carries out high-speed coordination, the endocrine system mainly controls:
(Nervous system tez raftar coordination karta hai, jabke endocrine system zyada tar kya control karta hai?)

options.text: sirf digestive juices ka ducts mein ikhraj
lambe arse ke amal jaise growth, metabolism aur reproduction

blocks.explanation: Endocrine system lambe arse ke amal jaise growth (barhna), metabolism aur reproduction control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: the endocrine system controls long-term processes like growth, metabolism, and reproduction

blocks.prompt:
2 Coordination carried out by sending hormones as chemical instructions to target body parts is called:
(Hormones ki shakal mein kimiyai hidayat target hisson ko bhej kar hone wali coordination ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Endocrine system hormones ki shakal mein kimiyai hidayat bhejta hai; ise chemical coordination (kimiyai rabta) kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: It is called chemical coordination

blocks.prompt:
3 A hormone is a regulatory chemical secreted by an endocrine gland into:
(Hormone aik regulatory chemical hai jo endocrine gland kahan kharij karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hormone endocrine gland khoon ya tissue fluid mein kharij karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A hormone is a regulatory chemical that is secreted into the blood or tissue fluid by an endocrine gland

blocks.prompt:
4 Blood carries a hormone to every cell of the body, but the hormone shows its effects:
(Khoon hormone ko jism ke har cell tak le jata hai, lekin hormone apna asar kahan dikhata hai?)

options.text: sirf apne makhsoos target cells mein

blocks.explanation: Hormone har cell tak pahunchta hai magar asar sirf apne makhsoos target cells mein dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: but it shows its effects only in its specific target cells

blocks.prompt:
5 Because target cells respond in a specific way on receiving them, hormones are also called:
(Target cells hormones milne par makhsoos tarah jawab dete hain, is liye hormones ko aur kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hormones ko chemical messengers (kimiyai paighambar) ya signalling molecules kaha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: hormones are referred to as chemical messengers or signalling molecules

blocks.prompt:
6 Glands that pour their secretion into ducts attached with them are called:
(Woh glands jo apni ratubat apne saath juri ducts mein dalte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Exocrine glands ratubat ducts (nali) mein dalte hain; endocrine glands ki ducts nahi hotin.

book_ref.quote: Exocrine glands secrete their secretion in ducts attached with them

blocks.prompt:
7 Endocrine glands secrete their hormones:
(Endocrine glands apne hormones kab kharij karte hain?)

options.text: har haal mein muqarrara raftar se musalsal

blocks.explanation: Endocrine glands makhsoos stimuli (tehreek) milne par hormones kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The endocrine glands secrete their hormones on receiving particular stimuli

blocks.prompt:
8 Receptors for hormones can be found:
(Hormones ke receptors kahan paye ja sakte hain?)

options.text: cell membrane par, cytoplasm ya nucleus mein

blocks.explanation: Receptors cell membrane par, cytoplasm mein ya nucleus mein ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Receptors can be found on the cell membrane, in the cytoplasm, or in the nucleus of a cell

blocks.prompt:
9 What happens when a hormone binds to its receptor?
(Jab hormone apne receptor se jurta hai to kya hota hai?)

options.text: jurna aise waqiaat shuru karta hai jo cell mein tabdeeli laate hain
hormone foran peshab mein nikal jata hai

blocks.explanation: Jurne se aise waqiaat shuru hote hain jo cell ke andar tabdeeliyan laate hain.

book_ref.quote: When a hormone binds to a receptor, the binding triggers events that lead to changes within the cell

blocks.prompt:
10 Compared with neurotransmitters, hormones are often:
(Neurotransmitters ke muqable mein hormones aksar kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hormones aksar dheere asar karte hain magar un ka asar zyada der rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Hormones are often slower acting and have longer effects than neurotransmitters

blocks.prompt:
11 On the basis of chemical nature, hormones are grouped into how many main categories?
(Kimiyai fitrat ki bunyad par hormones ko kitni bari qismon mein baanta jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar groups hain: peptide aur protein, glycoprotein, amino acid derivatives aur steroid hormones (kitab ki tasheeh: teen nahi, chaar).

book_ref.quote: Hormones are grouped into four main chemical categories

blocks.prompt:
12 Peptide and protein hormones dissolve easily in blood because they are:
(Peptide aur protein hormones khoon mein aasani se kyun hal ho jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh water-soluble (pani mein hal hone wale) hain, is liye khoon mein aasani se hal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: They are water-soluble, meaning they dissolve easily in blood

blocks.prompt:
13 Since peptide and protein hormones cannot pass through cell membranes, they:
(Peptide aur protein hormones cell membrane se guzar nahi sakte, is liye woh kya karte hain?)

options.text: cell ki satah ke receptors se jurte hain
nucleus ke receptors se jurte hain

blocks.explanation: Yeh membrane se nahi guzar sakte, is liye cell ki satah ke receptors se jurte hain.

book_ref.quote: So, they bind to receptors on the cell surface

blocks.prompt:
14 Glucagon, which raises blood glucose levels, belongs to which chemical group of hormones?
(Glucagon jo blood glucose barhata hai, hormones ke kis kimiyai group mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab insulin aur glucagon (pancreas) ko peptide aur protein hormones mein likhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Raises blood glucose levels.

blocks.prompt:
15 Glycoprotein hormones consist of:
(Glycoprotein hormones kis cheez se bane hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Glycoproteins conjugated proteins hain: protein ke saath carbohydrate (shakar) group.

book_ref.quote: They consist of a protein combined with a carbohydrate (sugar) group

blocks.prompt:
16 Glycoprotein hormones cannot pass through the cell membrane because they are:
(Glycoprotein hormones cell membrane se kyun nahi guzar sakte?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bare, pecheeda aur polar molecules hain, is liye membrane se nahi guzarte.

book_ref.quote: They are large, complex, and polar molecules

blocks.prompt:
17 Which glycoprotein hormone triggers ovulation in females and testosterone secretion in males?
(Kaun sa glycoprotein hormone auraton mein ovulation aur mardon mein testosterone ka ikhraj shuru karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Luteinizing hormone auraton mein ovulation aur mardon mein testosterone ka ikhraj karwata hai.

book_ref.quote: Triggers ovulation in females and secretion of testosterone in males.

blocks.prompt:
18 Which glycoprotein hormone stimulates sperm production or egg development?
(Kaun sa glycoprotein hormone sperm banne ya egg ki nashonuma ko tez karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Follicle stimulating hormone sperm banne ya egg ki nashonuma ko tez karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Stimulates sperm production or egg development.

blocks.prompt:
19 Amino acid derivative hormones are small molecules usually derived from:
(Amino acid derivative hormones aam taur par kis se bante hain?)

options.text: a chain of many amino acids
a protein and a sugar group

blocks.explanation: Yeh aik amino acid, aam taur par tyrosine ya tryptophan, se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: These are small molecules derived from a single amino acid (usually Tyrosine or Tryptophan)

blocks.prompt:
20 Which pair of amino acid derivative hormones CANNOT cross cell membranes?
(Amino acid derivative hormones ka kaun sa jora cell membrane se NAHI guzar sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Epinephrine aur norepinephrine membrane se nahi guzarte, jabke thyroxine aur tri-iodothyronine guzar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Epinephrine and norepinephrine cannot cross membranes while thyroxine and tri-iodothyronine can cross

blocks.prompt:
21 Hormone was discovered in 1902, during research on the digestive system, by:
(1902 mein digestive system par tehqeeq ke dauran hormone kis ne daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1902 mein British scientists Bayliss aur Starling ne hormone (secretin) daryaft kiya.

book_ref.quote: In 1902, two British scientists, Bayliss and Starling, discovered hormone

blocks.prompt:
22 Secretin, released when acidic gastric juice enters the small intestine, stimulates:
(Secretin, jo tezabi gastric juice ke small intestine mein aane par kharij hota hai, kis ko tehreek deta hai?)

options.text: maide ko gastric juice ke liye
pancreas ko pancreatic juice kharij karne ke liye
liver ko glycogen jama karne ke liye

blocks.explanation: Secretin pancreas tak pahunch kar use pancreatic juice kharij karne par ubharta hai.

book_ref.quote: Secretin reaches the pancreas and stimulates it to secrete pancreatic juice

blocks.prompt:
23 According to the table of amino acid derivative hormones, triiodothyronine (T₃) regulates:
(Amino acid derivative hormones ke table ke mutabiq triiodothyronine (T₃) kya regulate karta hai?)

options.text: jism ka darja hararat aur dil ki dharkan

blocks.explanation: T₃ (thyroid gland) jism ka darja hararat aur dil ki dharkan regulate karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Regulates body temperature and heart rate.

blocks.prompt:
24 Steroid hormones are derived from:
(Steroid hormones kis se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Steroid hormones cholesterol (aik qism ka lipid) se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: These hormones are derived from cholesterol (a type of lipid)

blocks.prompt:
25 Steroid hormones can move through the cell membrane to give instructions directly to the nucleus because they are:
(Steroid hormones cell membrane se guzar kar seedha nucleus ko hidayat kyun de sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Proteins ke bar-aks steroids lipid-soluble (charbi mein hal hone wale) hain, is liye membrane se guzar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Unlike proteins, steroids are lipid-soluble (fat-soluble)

blocks.prompt:
26 Which steroid hormone of the adrenal cortex helps the kidneys manage salt and water balance?
(Adrenal cortex ka kaun sa steroid hormone gurdon ko namak aur pani ka tawazun sambhalne mein madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldosterone (adrenal cortex) gurdon ko namak aur pani ka tawazun sambhalne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Helps the kidneys manage salt and water balance.

blocks.prompt:
27 Which of the following is a steroid hormone?
(In mein se kaun sa steroid hormone hai?)
blocks.explanation: Testosterone (testes) steroid hormone hai; yeh mardana reproductive tissues aur khususiyaat regulate karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Regulates male reproductive tissues and traits.

blocks.prompt:
28 The human endocrine system consists of:
(Insani endocrine system kis par mushtamil hai?)

options.text: woh glands aur organs jo hormones bana kar kharij karte hain
sirf ducts mein ratubat dalne wale glands

blocks.explanation: Yeh un glands aur organs par mushtamil hai jo jism ke kaamon ko regulate karne ke liye hormones banate aur kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The endocrine system of human beings consists of glands and organs that produce and secrete hormones

blocks.prompt:
29 The pituitary (master gland) is itself controlled by:
(Pituitary (master gland) khud kis ke control mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Master gland khud dimagh ke aik hisse hypothalamus ke control mein hai.

book_ref.quote: However, the master gland is itself controlled by a part of the brain i.e., hypothalamus

blocks.prompt:
30 The special cells of the hypothalamus that both conduct nerve impulses and secrete hormones are:
(Hypothalamus ke woh khas cells jo nerve impulses bhi le jate hain aur hormones bhi kharij karte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells nerve impulses bhi le jate hain aur hormones bhi kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: which not only conduct nerve impulses but also secrete hormones

blocks.prompt:
31 Hormones of the hypothalamus reach the anterior pituitary through:
(Hypothalamus ke hormones anterior pituitary tak kis raste pahunchte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khoon ki naliyan hypothalamus ko anterior pituitary se jorti hain; hormones in ke zariye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Blood vessels connect hypothalamus with the anterior pituitary

blocks.prompt:
32 Releasing hormones of the hypothalamus:
(Hypothalamus ke releasing hormones kya karte hain?)

options.text: anterior pituitary ko hormones banane aur kharij karne par ubharte hain
posterior pituitary mein jama hote hain
seedha gurdon par asar karte hain

blocks.explanation: Releasing hormones anterior pituitary ko hormones banane aur kharij karne par ubharte hain; inhibiting hormones rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: Releasing hormones stimulate the anterior pituitary to make and secrete hormones.

blocks.prompt:
33 Somatostatin, a hormone of the hypothalamus, causes:
(Hypothalamus ka hormone somatostatin kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Somatostatin growth hormone ko rokta hai; growth hormone releasing-hormone use kharij karwata hai.

book_ref.quote: Inhibition of growth hormone

blocks.prompt:
34 Prolactin inhibiting factor of the hypothalamus is actually:
(Hypothalamus ka prolactin inhibiting factor asal mein kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prolactin inhibiting factor asal mein dopamine hai; yeh prolactin ka ikhraj rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: Prolactin inhibiting factor – which is actually dopamine

blocks.prompt:
35 Gonadotropin releasing hormone causes the anterior pituitary to secrete:
(Gonadotropin releasing hormone anterior pituitary se kya kharij karwata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gonadotropin releasing hormone FSH aur LH ka ikhraj karwata hai.

book_ref.quote: Gonadotropin releasing hormone

blocks.prompt:
36 Thyrotropin releasing hormone (TRH) causes the secretion of:
(Thyrotropin releasing hormone (TRH) kis ka ikhraj karwata hai?)
blocks.explanation: TRH anterior pituitary se TSH kharij karwata hai.

book_ref.quote: Secretion of thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH)

blocks.prompt:
37 Oxytocin and ADH reach the posterior pituitary from the hypothalamus through:
(Oxytocin aur ADH hypothalamus se posterior pituitary tak kis zariye pahunchte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Neurosecretory cells ke axons oxytocin aur ADH ko posterior pituitary tak le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The axons of neurosecretory cells transport oxytocin and ADH to the posterior pituitary

blocks.prompt:
38 In the posterior pituitary, oxytocin and ADH are:
(Posterior pituitary mein oxytocin aur ADH ke saath kya hota hai?)

options.text: amino acids se banaye jate hain
jama rehte hain aur baad mein khoon mein chhore jate hain

blocks.explanation: Yeh posterior pituitary mein jama rehte hain aur baad mein khoon mein chhore jate hain.

book_ref.quote: where they are stored for eventual release into blood

blocks.prompt:
39 The stalk that attaches the pituitary gland to the hypothalamus is called:
(Pituitary gland ko hypothalamus se jorne wali dandi ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pituitary hypothalamus se infundibulum naam ki dandi ke zariye juri hai.

book_ref.quote: Pituitary gland is attached to hypothalamus by a stalk called infundibulum

blocks.prompt:
40 The pituitary gland is divided into how many lobes?
(Pituitary gland kitne lobes mein taqseem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teen lobes: anterior, posterior aur intermediate (median) pituitary.

book_ref.quote: Pituitary gland is divided into three lobes

blocks.prompt:
41 Growth hormone is also called:
(Growth hormone ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Growth hormone (GH) ko somatotropin bhi kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Growth Hormone (GH, or somatotropin) stimulates the growth of muscles

blocks.prompt:
42 According to the chapter, growth hormone stimulates the growth of bones:
(Kitab ke mutabiq growth hormone haddiyon ki growth ko kaise tehreek deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: GH muscles, haddiyon (bilwasta) aur doosre tissues ki growth tez karta hai.

book_ref.quote: stimulates the growth of muscles, bones (indirectly), and other tissues

blocks.prompt:
43 ACTH (corticotropin) of the anterior pituitary stimulates:
(Anterior pituitary ka ACTH (corticotropin) kis ko tehreek deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: ACTH adrenal cortex ko corticosteroids kharij karne par ubharta hai.

book_ref.quote: Adrenocorticotropic Hormone (ACTH, or corticotropin) stimulates the adrenal cortex

blocks.prompt:
44 The corticosteroids secreted under the effect of ACTH regulate:
(ACTH ke asar se kharij hone wale corticosteroids kya regulate karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Corticosteroids glucose aur namak ki homeostasis (tawazun) regulate karte hain.

book_ref.quote: which regulate glucose and salt homeostasis

blocks.prompt:
45 Thyroid-stimulating hormone is also called:
(Thyroid-stimulating hormone ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: TSH ko thyrotropin bhi kehte hain; yeh thyroid se thyroxine banwata hai.

book_ref.quote: Thyroid-stimulating Hormone (TSH, or thyrotropin)

blocks.prompt:
46 Which two anterior pituitary hormones are called gonadotropins?
(Anterior pituitary ke kaun se do hormones gonadotropins kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: FSH aur LH dono ko gonadotropins kaha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: FSH and LH are both referred to as gonadotropins

blocks.prompt:
47 In females, FSH stimulates:
(Auraton mein FSH kis cheez ko tehreek deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: FSH auraton mein ovarian follicles aur mardon mein sperms ki nashonuma tez karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Follicle-stimulating Hormone (FSH) stimulates the development of ovarian follicles in females

blocks.prompt:
48 Prolactin is produced in both sexes but functions:
(Prolactin dono jinson mein banta hai magar kaam kis mein karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prolactin mard aur aurat dono mein banta hai magar kaam sirf aurat mein karta hai (doodh banana).

book_ref.quote: It is produced in both male and female but functions only in female

blocks.prompt:
49 The anterior pituitary hormone that stimulates the mammary glands to PRODUCE milk is:
(Anterior pituitary ka kaun sa hormone mammary glands mein doodh BANATA hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prolactin doodh banwata hai; oxytocin (posterior pituitary) doodh bahar nikalwata hai.

book_ref.quote: Prolactin stimulates the mammary glands to produce milk

blocks.prompt:
50 Growth hormone therapy may not be appropriate for every short person because:
(Growth hormone therapy har chhote qad wale ke liye munasib kyun nahi?)

options.text: GH injection se nahi diya ja sakta
har dwarf mein GH ki kami nahi hoti
GH dimagh ki nashonuma rok deta hai

blocks.explanation: GH ilaj sirf GH ki kami wale bachon ki madad karta hai; har dwarf (pasta qad) mein GH ki kami nahi hoti.

book_ref.quote: However, every dwarf person does not have GH deficiency

blocks.prompt:
51 The intermediate pituitary produces:
(Intermediate pituitary kaun sa hormone banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Intermediate pituitary MSH banata hai.

book_ref.quote: It produces melanocyte stimulating hormone (MSH)

blocks.prompt:
52 MSH stimulates melanocytes in skin and hair to produce and release:
(MSH jild aur baalon ke melanocytes se kya banwata aur kharij karwata hai?)
blocks.explanation: MSH jild aur baalon ke melanocytes se melanin banwata aur kharij karwata hai.

book_ref.quote: MSH stimulates the production and release of melanin by melanocytes in skin and hair

blocks.prompt:
53 Over-secretion of growth hormone in a growing child causes:
(Barhte bache mein growth hormone ki zyadti se kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Barhte bache mein GH ki zyadti gigantism (bohat lamba qad) paida karti hai.

book_ref.quote: it causes gigantism i.e., height that is well above average

blocks.prompt:
54 In acromegaly (GH over-secretion in adult life), the bones:
(Acromegaly (baaligh umr mein GH ki zyadti) mein haddiyan kya karti hain?)

options.text: motai mein barhti hain, lambai mein nahi
naram aur tehri ho jati hain
bilkul barhna band kar deti hain

blocks.explanation: Baaligh mein haddiyan lambai mein nahi barhtin magar motai mein barhti hain; haath, paon, khopri, naak aur jabra bare ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: bones are no longer capable of increasing in length but grow in thickness

blocks.prompt:
55 In dwarfism due to GH deficiency:
(GH ki kami se hone wale dwarfism mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: haath paon bare ho jate hain
jism ke hisse mutanasib rehte hain aur IQ par asar nahi
hisse ghair mutanasib ho jate hain

blocks.explanation: Dwarfism mein qad chhota rehta hai magar jism ke hisse mutanasib rehte hain; dimagh aur IQ par asar nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: However, the body parts stay in proportion and brain development and IQ are unaffected

blocks.prompt:
56 Diabetes insipidus, caused by under-secretion of ADH, is characterized by:
(ADH ki kami se hone wala diabetes insipidus kis cheez se pehchana jata hai?)

options.text: bohat zyada patla peshab aur bar bar pyaas

blocks.explanation: ADH ki kami se diabetes insipidus hota hai: bohat zyada patla peshab aur bar bar pyaas.

book_ref.quote: It is characterized by excessive production of dilute urine and frequent thirst

blocks.prompt:
57 Under-secretion of oxytocin:
(Oxytocin ki kami se kya hota hai?)

options.text: wiladat ka normal amal rukta hai

blocks.explanation: Oxytocin ki kami wiladat ke normal amal ko rok deti hai.

book_ref.quote: under secretion of oxytocin inhibits normal labour process

blocks.prompt:
58 The posterior pituitary:
(Posterior pituitary ke bare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?)

options.text: sirf hypothalamus ke hormones jama aur kharij karta hai

blocks.explanation: Posterior pituitary koi hormone nahi banata; sirf hypothalamus ke banaye hormones jama aur kharij karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It does not synthesize any hormone but only stores and releases the hormones made by hypothalamus

blocks.prompt:
59 Antidiuretic hormone is also known as:
(Antidiuretic hormone ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: ADH ya vasopressin gurdon mein pani rokne ka kaam karwata hai.

book_ref.quote: Antidiuretic Hormone (ADH or vasopressin) stimulates water retention by the kidneys

blocks.prompt:
60 Oxytocin brings about milk-ejection by:
(Oxytocin doodh ka ikhraj kaise karwata hai?)

options.text: gland cells se doodh banwa kar
mammary glands ke smooth muscles ko sukerh kar
mammary glands ko dheela kar ke

blocks.explanation: Oxytocin mammary glands ke smooth muscles ko sukerh kar doodh bahar nikalwata hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxytocin stimulates the milk-ejection by stimulating the contraction of smooth muscles of mammary glands

blocks.prompt:
61 During embryonic development, the posterior pituitary is formed from:
(Embryo ki nashonuma mein posterior pituitary kis se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh neural tissue ke ubhar se banta hai, is liye hypothalamus se axons ke tract ke zariye jura rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: During embryonic development, posterior pituitary is formed from an outgrowth of neural tissue

blocks.prompt:
62 The uterus of a breast-feeding mother returns to normal size more quickly because:
(Doodh pilane wali maa ka uterus jaldi normal size par kyun aata hai?)

options.text: prolactin bilkul band ho jata hai
wiladat ke baad oxytocin ka ikhraj jari rehta hai

blocks.explanation: Doodh pilane wali maaon mein wiladat ke baad bhi oxytocin ka ikhraj jari rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: the uterus of a nursing mother returns to its normal size after pregnancy more quickly

blocks.prompt:
63 The thyroid gland is:
(Thyroid gland kaisa hai?)

options.text: titli numa, gardan ke saamne trachea ke dono taraf

blocks.explanation: Thyroid titli numa hai, gardan ke saamne trachea ke dono taraf, do jure lobes ke saath.

book_ref.quote: It is a butterfly-shaped gland located on either side of the trachea in the front of neck

blocks.prompt:
64 Which thyroid hormone is the more active and powerful form?
(Thyroid ka kaun sa hormone zyada active aur taqatwar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thyroid T₄ zyada banata hai jo T₃ mein badalta hai; T₃ zyada active aur taqatwar hai.

book_ref.quote: Thyroid produces much more T₄, which eventually converts into T₃

blocks.prompt:
65 In the liver, T₄ and T₃ enhance:
(Liver mein T₄ aur T₃ kis amal ko tez karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh liver mein glucose catabolism (torna) aur cholesterol banne ko tez karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They also enhance glucose catabolism and synthesis of cholesterol in liver

blocks.prompt:
66 In children, thyroid hormones promote:
(Bachon mein thyroid hormones kis cheez ko barhate hain?)

options.text: dhanche ki growth aur dimagh ki nashonuma

blocks.explanation: Bachon mein T₄ aur T₃ dhanche ki growth aur dimagh ki nashonuma barhate hain.

book_ref.quote: In children, they promote growth of the skeleton and the development of brain

blocks.prompt:
67 When blood calcium rises too high, calcitonin:
(Jab khoon mein calcium bohat barh jaye to calcitonin kya karta hai?)

options.text: haddi ka calcium khoon mein ghol deta hai
vitamin D ko active karta hai
calcium haddiyon mein jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium kam karta hai
gurdon se calcium wapas jazb karwata hai

blocks.explanation: Calcitonin calcium ko haddiyon mein jazb karwa kar khoon mein us ki miqdar kam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: calcitonin stimulates the absorption of calcium into bones, thus lowering its level in blood

blocks.prompt:
68 The thyroid gland is often called the body's:
(Thyroid gland ko aksar jism ka kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ke hormones tay karte hain ke har cell kitna tez ya aahista kaam kare, is liye ise Master Controller of Metabolism kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: because its hormones dictate how fast or slow every cell in body works

blocks.prompt:
69 Graves' disease is:
(Graves' disease kya hai?)

options.text: autoimmune marz jo hyperthyroidism karta hai

blocks.explanation: Graves' disease aik autoimmune (jism ka apne khilaf) marz hai jo hyperthyroidism paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: is an autoimmune disease that causes hyperthyroidism

blocks.prompt:
70 Exophthalmia, which may result from Graves' disease, is:
(Exophthalmia, jo Graves' disease se ho sakta hai, kya hai?)

options.text: aankhon ke dhelon ka bahar ubharna

blocks.explanation: Exophthalmia aankhon ke dhelon ka bahar ubharna hai.

book_ref.quote: Exophthalmia (protrusion of the eyeballs) may also result from Graves

blocks.prompt:
71 Hypothyroidism during foetal and childhood development causes:
(Janeen aur bachpan mein hypothyroidism se kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Janeen aur bachpan mein hypothyroidism cretinism paida karta hai: ruki hui growth aur zehni pasmandgi.
